description: This file defines a base class for retrieving tenant information and authentication IDs from various sources such as X509 certificates and username strings. It includes methods for extracting data from SSL sessions, certificates, and user name formats, and interacts with external tenant client services.

classes.name: BaseExecutionContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: A base class providing methods for extracting tenant and authentication ID information from SSL certificates, SSL sessions, and username strings, utilizing external tenant client services.

methods.name: getFromClientCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves tenant info based on the client's SSL certificate from the SSL session.

methods.name: getFromClientCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves tenant info directly from a given X509 certificate.

methods.name: getX509Cert
methods.description: Extracts the X509Certificate from the SSL session if available.

methods.name: getFromUserName
methods.description: Parses a username in 'authId@tenantId' format to retrieve tenant info, considering single or multi-tenant configurations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant info from X500Principal and subject distinguished name, via tenant client.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant info from tenant ID and auth ID, via tenant client.
